title: Criterion-Explicit Reproducibility of Matrix-Remodelling Candidates in Osteoarthritis Synovium — analysis code
description: Analysis code accompanying the manuscript Criterion-Explicit Reproducibility of Matrix-Remodelling Candidates in Osteoarthritis Synovium. The code covers per-cohort differential expression, merged effects and leave-one-cohort-out re-ranking, donor-resolved single-cell localisation, the cross-linker family under one criterion framework, and cis-eQTL Mendelian randomisation checks. All primary data are public (GEO; Alasoo and GTEx eQTL portals).
